profile.headline: Autonomy Simulation Engineer at Wisk
profile.summary: Hello! I'm Adrian a recent grad from the MIT Aeroastro program with a minor in Computer Science. I am currently a Software Engineer and am passionate about autonomous systems and robotics.

positions.title: Autonomous Vehicle Software Engineer
positions.description: Software test engineer for Boeing aircraft. Led development of test case generation and supported onboarding peers.
positions.insights: Skills: Stateflow · Software Requirements · Simulink · Test Case Generation · Agile

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description:
- Developing Flight Test Instrumentation for X-65 plane that will be used to analyze the validity of active flow control. 
- Used containerization scheme for integrated testing with simulation. 
- Worked using the agile scrum method to consistently keep team members and managers updated for a quick turnaround on project tasks.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developing a multi-agent robot designed to traverse dangerous terrain in space.
Implementing SLAM in Linux and ROS 2 to generate a map of the WORMS surroundings.

positions.title: MIT Rocket Team: Composites
positions.description: Developing a two-stage space shot rocket as a part of the team's aerodynamics subteam.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
Developing software and simulations to model and optimize directional recrystallization (DRX) of additively manufactured superalloys.
Ran experiments to characterize superalloy specimens through the DRX process.

positions.title: Makerspace Assistant
positions.description:
Taught students how to use a laser cutter, band saw, and drill press among other maker tools to design their own pinball machines. 
Served as a mentor for students as they designed the parts for their machines.

positions.title: SpaceNet Cloud Developer
positions.description: Web development for SpaceNet Cloud: a program that will model the feasibility of space exploration campaigns.

courses.name: Computational Modeling and Data Analysis in Aerospace Engineering

honors.issuer: Issued by College Board National Recognition Programs · Sep 2019
